searchText: hey everyone! can please anyone tell me if there is a way to test the prefix change for withdrawal https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/withdrawals-guide now? At least it should be possible to send them back to the address they came from. There has to be a way out. But the address the came from is of no importance at all. Those addresses might even have been compromised in the meantime. I wouldn't get my hopes up of a way out; "keep your mnemonic safe" was in huge bold letters everywhere. yeah you can test on Goerli where the Capella upgrade is already live, info: <https://goerli.launchpad.ethereum.org/en/withdrawals>
